digest.component_or_area: MCP model schema generation and validation
propositions: BridgeFsckOut pydantic model declares three properties while bridge_fsck.schema.json declares four; binding_drift field is missing from the model but emitted unconditionally by _engine_support/bridge_fsck.py and present in generated types.py
VerifySignatureResultOut makes algorithm, head_sha, and key_id optional in the model while the schema requires all three to be present

_mcp_models.py contains five hand-mirrored schemas with explicit Mirror comments but no generator or drift gate, unlike the TypedDict layer which uses schemas/gen_types.py with CI enforcement via --check flag
The comment at _mcp_models.py:31-34 claims cross-interface schema tests pin BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, and WorkflowRunOut models to canonical schemas, but no such tests exist in tests/
MCP model layer lacks the equivalent drift detection and enforcement mechanism that exists for the sibling TypedDict layer generated from schemas
